```{r load seurat objects}

seurat <- readRDS("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Co-culture_timecourse/microglia_d3_d15_d30_d58_integrated.rds")
seurat$type <- "invitro"

## DE to primary fetal microglia
seurat_MG <- readRDS("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Co-culture_timecourse/Kracht_primary_microglia_seurat.rds")
seurat_MG$type <- "primary"

```

Generate a SingleCellExperiment object 
```{r generate a SingleCellExperiment object}

# Extract raw counts and metadata to create SingleCellExperiment object
counts <- seurat@assays$RNA@counts 

metadata <- seurat@meta.data

# Set up metadata as desired for aggregation and DE analysis
metadata$cluster_id <- factor(seurat@active.ident)

# Create single cell experiment object
sce <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(counts = counts), 
                           colData = metadata)

```

Take a look at the count matrix
```{r count matrix and metadata}

# Explore the raw counts for the dataset

## Check the assays present
assays(sce)

## Check the counts matrix
dim(counts(sce))
counts(sce)[1:6, 1:6]

# Explore the cellular metadata for the dataset

dim(colData(sce))
head(colData(sce))

# Add a column with cluster and condition
sce$condition_celltype <- paste0(sce$condition, "_", sce$celltype)
sce$condition_timepoint <- paste0(sce$condition, "_", sce$timepoint)
sce$condition_timepoint_celltype <- paste0(sce$condition, "_", sce$timepoint, "_", sce$celltype)
sce$condition <- factor(sce$condition, levels = c("CTRL", "COCUL"))
sce$timepoint <- factor(sce$timepoint, levels = c("D3", "D15", "D30", "D58"))

# Extract unique names of samples (= levels of sample_id factor variable)
sample_names <- levels(colData(sce)$orig.ident)
sample_names

# Total number of samples
length(sample_names)

```

```{r}

# Subset metadata to include only the variables you want to aggregate across (here, we want to aggregate by condition and by timepoint)
groups <- colData(sce)[, c("condition", "timepoint", "celltype")]
head(groups)

```

Aggregate the counts to generate a matrix with count sums
```{r generate an aggregated matrix of counts per sample}

# Aggregate across cluster-sample groups
# transposing row/columns to have cell_ids as row names matching those of groups
aggr_counts <- aggregate.Matrix(t(counts(sce)), 
                                groupings = groups, fun = "sum") 

# Explore output matrix
class(aggr_counts)
dim(aggr_counts)
aggr_counts[1:6, 1:6]

# Now transpose the matrix back so we can easilty use it to do DE analysis
# Transpose aggregated matrix to have genes as rows and samples as columns
aggr_counts <- t(aggr_counts)
aggr_counts[1:6, 1:6]

```

Generate matching metadata at the sample-level
```{r}

# Explore structure of metadata
head(colData(sce))

# Extract sample-level variables
metadata <- colData(sce) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::select(condition, timepoint, condition_timepoint, condition_timepoint_celltype)

dim(metadata)
head(metadata)

# Exclude duplicated rows
metadata <- metadata[!duplicated(metadata), ]

dim(metadata)
head(metadata)

# Rename rows
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$condition_timepoint_celltype
head(metadata)

# Check the number of cells per sample and cluster
t <- table(colData(sce)$condition,
           colData(sce)$timepoint)
t
type(t)

aggr_counts[1:6, 1:6]
head(metadata)

# Check matching of matrix columns and metadata rows
all(colnames(aggr_counts) == rownames(metadata)) 
# They do not, so we make them match
metadata <- metadata[match(colnames(aggr_counts), rownames(metadata)), ]


```

```{r create DESEq2 dataframe}

# Create DESeq2 object        
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(aggr_counts, 
                              colData = metadata, 
                              design = ~ condition + timepoint + timepoint:condition)

```
```{r LRT}

dds <- DESeq(dds, test="LRT", reduced = ~ condition + timepoint)
resTC <- results(dds)
resTC$symbol <- mcols(dds)$symbol
head(resTC[order(resTC$padj),],4)

```
```{r}

data <- plotCounts(dds, which.min(resTC$padj),
                   intgroup = c("timepoint", "condition"), returnData = TRUE)
ggplot(data, aes(x = timepoint, y = count, color = condition, group = condition)) + 
  geom_point() + stat_smooth(se = FALSE, method = "loess") + scale_y_log10()

```
```{r}

resultsNames(dds)

betas <- coef(dds)
colnames(betas)

topGenes <- head(order(resTC$padj),30)
mat <- betas[topGenes, -c(1,2)]
thr <- 3
mat[mat < -thr] <- -thr
mat[mat > thr] <- thr

pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/DESeq2_heatmap_DE_across_timepoints_and_interaction_terms.pdf",  width = 6, height = 8)
pheatmap(mat, breaks=seq(from=-thr, to=thr, length=101),
	  cluster_col=FALSE, color =bluered_colscheme(100)) 
dev.off()

```

```{r}

resTC <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "CTRL", "COCUL"))

# Turn the DESeq2 results object into a tibble for use with tidyverse functions
res_tbl <- resTC %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "gene") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  arrange(padj)

# Check results output
res_tbl 

```
```{r}

res30 <- results(dds, name = "conditionCOCUL.timepointD30", test = "Wald")
res30[which.min(resTC$padj),]

# Turn the DESeq2 results object into a tibble for use with tidyverse functions
res30_tbl <- res30 %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "gene") %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  arrange(padj)

# Check results output
res30_tbl 

# Set thresholds
padj_cutoff <- 0.05

# Subset the significant results
sig_res <- dplyr::filter(res30_tbl) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(padj) %>%
  mutate(DE = abs(log2FoldChange)>log(1.5) & padj < 0.01) %>%
  mutate(DEG = ifelse(abs(log2FoldChange)>log(1.5) & padj < 0.01, gene, NA))

# Check significant genes output
sig_res

# Add to the table another column wtih outcome
sig_res <- sig_res %>% 
  mutate(
    outcome = case_when(log2FoldChange > log(1.5) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Up-regulated",
                           log2FoldChange < -log(1.5) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Down-regulated",
                           TRUE ~ "Unchanged")
    )
head(sig_res) 

de_markers_cocul <- c("CNN3", "SERPINE2", "PURPL", "LARP6", "PRSS23", "IRX2", "MXRA5", "PAPPA", "MEG3", "ASCL1", "FST", "MID1", "COL11A1", "EDIL3", "KIF5C", "MPAS1", "SLC7A11", "HTRA", "CLDN1", "HSPA8", "IL32", "MOXD1", "MAP1B", "CXCL6", # up-regulated in control
                "MMP12", "FABP4", "PRTG", "DLK1", "APCDD1", "TRDN", "DCLK1", "THSD7A", "TOX3", "NPPC", "MMP1", "NPPC", "BIRC7", "CSF3R", "CRMP1" # up-regulated in co-culture
          )

de_markers <- sig_res %>% filter(gene %in% de_markers_cocul)

plot <- ggplot(sig_res, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(shape=21, size=2, aes(fill=factor(outcome)), position = "jitter") +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(0),  linetype="dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.01), linetype="dotted") +
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#58B6AC", "gray50", "#C73E04")) +
  xlab(expression("log"[2]*"FC")) + 
  ylab(expression("-log"[10]*"p_adj")) +
  ggtitle("DEGs from day 3 to day 30 in microglia-coculture vs microglia in vitro")

plot <- plot +
  geom_label_repel(data = de_markers, mapping = aes(log2FoldChange, -log10(padj), label = gene), size = 3, max.overlaps = 70) 

pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/DESeq2_volcano_DE_day30_cocul_vs_ctrl_changed_from_day3.pdf", height = 5, width = 8)
plot 
dev.off()

```
